title: Why Do Humans Tell Stories?
paragraphs: Every culture in the world has stories. Children listen to fairy tales, friends share funny stories and millions of people watch films and series every day.
Long before writing, people told stories out loud. They told them again and again, and in this way they passed on history, rules and important knowledge to the next generation.
One of the oldest written stories is the Epic of Gilgamesh from ancient Mesopotamia. It is about a king who goes on a long journey and wants to live forever.
Scientists think stories help us in two ways. They make information easier to remember, and they help us understand how other people think and feel.
